title: 第11章 重新振作第12章 捡漏外挂
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
陆沉强压着喜悦的心情回到陆家，陆家的仆人们纷纷行礼：“少爷。”
目光中更多的是带着一丝怜悯，他们也都很同情陆沉的遭遇。
陆沉满怀愧疚地来到母亲的房间，缓步走到陆母的榻前，只见陆母正闭目休息，原本神采奕奕的母亲，此刻已经消瘦的不成样子，额头的皱纹肉眼可见地变多了不少，原本的一头黑发此刻也夹杂着几根银丝。
“母亲！”
陆沉小声哽咽着，生怕打扰到母亲休息。
陆沉泪眼婆娑地问道：“统子，有没有什么办法能救好我母亲？”
“她主要是心气郁结，能让她恢复的药很多的。”
“那你给我派任务，我去做！”
陆沉目光中带着焦急。
9527摇了摇头说道：“以你现在的状态做不了多少事情，首先要让你恢复过来，而且她的心结是你，只有你好起来她才能更好的恢复。”
陆沉闻言陷入深深的自责，开始小声抽泣着。
陆母似乎感应到了什么，眉头紧锁，缓缓睁开眼睛，看着眼前的陆沉，脸上挤出一丝慈爱的微笑：“沉儿，你都好久没来看我了。”
听了母亲的话，陆沉再也控制不住自己，一头扑进母亲的怀里，嚎啕大哭起来：“母亲，都是我的错，都是我把您害成这副样子的，是我不孝……”
眼泪和鼻涕混杂在一起流了下来。
陆母只是慈爱地抱着陆沉，一只手温柔地抚摸着陆沉的头：“没事的沉儿，这不怪你，母亲知道你心里苦，母亲只要看到你好好的母亲就很开心了。”
陆沉眼睛通红地叮嘱陆母：“母亲，孩儿以后一定重新振作起来，您一定要好好休息把身体养好，千万不要再让病情加重了。”
“嗯，母亲相信沉儿，我家儿子以后可是要成为顶天立地的大英雄的，母亲还没看到你成家立业，怎么舍得撒手而去呢。”
陆母一边说着，一边伸手给陆沉擦拭眼泪，脸上挂着欣慰的笑容。
就在这时，门口处传来一声瓷器落地的声音，回头一看，陆凯之正怔怔地站在那里，手里的药碗掉在地上碎了一地，他不敢置信地看着陆沉，试探性地说道：“沉，沉儿？”
“父亲！”

陆沉回应道，随即扑通一声跪倒在地，一头磕在地上：“父亲，这些年是孩儿不孝，让您和母亲担心了。”
陆凯之见状连忙去扶：“沉儿你别自责，这些事情不怪你，我们知道你心里难受，我们不怪你，你能好好的就好。”
说着，陆凯之将陆沉用力扶起，再度感受到父亲那双有力的大手传来的温度，陆沉的泪水再度不争气地落了下来。
一家三口紧紧地抱在一起，有泪水也有欣慰。
平复了情绪，陆沉认真地说道：“父亲，母亲，你们放心，我一定会重新振兴咱们陆家的。”
陆凯之拍了拍儿子的肩膀，语重心长地说：“沉儿，别给自己太多压力，家族还有我呢，另外当年那个人为父也一直在查，当日的仇为父一定想办法给你报。”
一旁的9527听见后，连忙提醒陆沉：“苟宿主，告诉你老爸，别查了，那人你们暂时惹不起，再查下去只会是惹祸上身。”
陆沉闻言点点头，告诉陆父：“父亲，不要再查下去了。”
“那不行，那人把我儿子害成这个样子，我怎么能不报仇！”
“父亲，那人实力太强大了，我们现在查下去只会惹祸上身，等孩儿有了足够的实力，一定亲手报仇。”
看到陆沉目光坚定的样子，陆凯之只好欣慰地点点头：“你不要给自己太大压力，相比家族振兴，为父更希望你能平平安安地长大。”
“父亲放心，我不会像之前那样毛毛躁躁的。
时间不早了，孩儿先回去了，母亲注意休息。”
陆沉贴心地给陆母盖好被子。
夫妻俩虽然不知道陆沉怎么了，但能看出来自己的儿子已经开始振作起来了，满脸的欣慰：“你也早点休息。”
content_en:
Lu Chen suppressed his joy and returned to the Lu family. The servants of the Lu family saluted: "Young Master."
There was more of a trace of pity in their eyes, and they all sympathized with Lu Chen's experience.
Lu Chen came to his mother's room full of guilt and walked slowly to Mother Lu's bed. He saw Mother Lu resting with her eyes closed. Her mother, who was originally full of energy, was now extremely thin. The wrinkles on her forehead had become more visible to the naked eye. Her original black hair was now mixed with a few silver strands.
"Mother!"
Lu Chen choked softly, for fear of disturbing his mother's rest.
Lu Chen asked with tears in his eyes: "Tongzi, is there any way to save my mother?"
"She is mainly depressed, and there are many medicines that can help her recover."
"Then you give me a task and I'll do it!"
Lu Chen's eyes were anxious.
9527 shook his head and said: "You can't do much in your current state. We need to make you recover first, and her heart is with you. Only when you get better can she recover better."
Lu Chen fell into deep self-blame upon hearing this and began to sob quietly.
Mother Lu seemed to sense something, her brows furrowed, she slowly opened her eyes, looked at Lu Chen in front of her, and squeezed out a loving smile on her face: "Shen'er, you haven't come to see me for a long time."
After hearing what his mother said, Lu Chen couldn't control himself anymore. He threw himself into his mother's arms and burst into tears: "Mom, it's all my fault. It's all my fault that made you like this. It's me who is unfilial..."
Tears and snot mixed together flowed down.
Mother Lu just hugged Lu Shen lovingly and gently stroked Lu Shen's head with one hand: "It's okay Shen'er, it's not your fault. Mother knows that you are suffering. Mother will be very happy as long as she sees you being a good mother."
Lu Chen's eyes were red and he warned Mother Lu: "Mother, my child will definitely get back on his feet in the future. You must have a good rest and take good care of your body. Don't let your condition get worse."
"Well, mother believes in Shen'er. My son will become a great hero in the future. Mother hasn't seen you get married and start a career, so how can she be willing to let go."
As Mother Lu spoke, she reached out to wipe Lu Chen's tears with a happy smile on her face.
At this moment, there was a sound of porcelain falling to the ground at the door. Looking back, Lu Kaizhi was standing there in a daze. The medicine bowl in his hand fell to the ground and broke to pieces. He looked at Lu Chen in disbelief and said tentatively: "Shen, Shen'er?"
"Father!"
Lu Chen responded, then he knelt down with a plop and knocked his head on the ground: "Father, the children have been unfilial these years, which has made you and mother worried."
Seeing this, Lu Kaizhi hurriedly went to help: "Shen'er, don't blame yourself. You are not to blame for these things. We know that you are feeling uncomfortable. We don't blame you. As long as you can be well."
With that said, Lu Kaizhi lifted Lu Chen up with all his strength, and once again felt the warmth from his father's strong hands, Lu Chen's tears fell again unsatisfactorily.
The family of three hugged each other tightly, with tears and relief.
After calming down, Lu Chen said seriously: "Father, mother, don't worry, I will definitely revitalize our Lu family."
Lu Kaizhi patted his son on the shoulder and said sincerely: "Shen'er, don't put too much pressure on yourself. The family still has me. In addition, that man's father has been investigating. The father will definitely find a way to avenge you."
After hearing this, 9527 on the side quickly reminded Lu Chen: "Host Gou, tell your dad to stop investigating. You can't afford to offend that person for the time being. If you continue to investigate, you will only get into trouble."
Lu Chen nodded when he heard this and told Father Lu: "Father, please stop investigating."
"That's not okay. That person hurt my son like this. How can I not take revenge!"
"Father, that man is too powerful. If we continue to investigate now, we will only get into trouble. Wait for the child toIf you have enough strength, you must take revenge with your own hands. "
Seeing the firm look in Lu Chen's eyes, Lu Kaizhi could only nod with relief: "Don't put too much pressure on yourself. Rather than revitalizing the family, my father hopes that you can grow up in peace. "
"Father, don't worry, I won't be as frizzy as before.
It's getting late, the child has gone back first, and the mother needs to take a rest. "
Lu Chen carefully covered Mother Lu with a quilt.
Although the couple didn't know what happened to Lu Chen, they could see that their son had begun to cheer up, and their faces were filled with relief: "You should also go to bed early. "
